what_changed: CFPB advisory opinion under Regulation F (12 CFR 1006) reminding debt collectors that the FDCPA and Regulation F prohibitions on false, deceptive or misleading representations and on unfair or unconscionable means apply to collecting medical debt. Applicable December 3, 2024.
compliant_agent_must_now: Third-party collectors (FDCPA debt collectors) only: do not represent or attempt to collect amounts that are not owed or not authorized. Whether this reaches consumer-loan collection beyond medical debt is not settled from the abstract.
open_questions_for_deploying_team: Does the deployment collect any medical debt, or only consumer loans? If only consumer loans, does the opinion's reading of 12 CFR 1006.18 and 1006.22 change any existing collection script?
rationale: Reg F advisory opinion interpreting 1006.18/1006.22, which govern collectors generally, but its subject is medical debt, which is outside consumer-loan servicing. Relevance depends on whether the interpretation reaches non-medical debts; confidence kept low for Stage B. Stage A: title, abstract, metadata and eCFR diff excerpt only; full text not read.
